lessons_used: Predictions were consistently too high across tests compared to noise-corrected measurements.
new_flow changes in adoption and home were helpful, as both produced confirmed winning tests.
finish, redesign and sign_in, reorder changes were tested twice each and showed no positive effect or worsened performance.
home, wait_info changes were tested twice and showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for all other specific kinds of changes because each has only been tested once.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Habit Selection Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive habit selection flow during adoption where users choose work breaks and companion activity preferences before generating their pet.
candidates.why: Adoption step has a 63.3% conversion rate and takes 89s median / 1017s mean. Adding personal habit context improves engagement and relevance before desktop spawn.

new_habit_flow.headline: How should your companion fit into your workday?
new_habit_flow.body: Select when your desktop pet should offer break reminders or playful animations.

guard.reason: Valid addition of an interactive habit selection flow within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Target step adoption loses 36.7% of users. adoption new_flow has strong track record (+1.1% measured), but costs a full flow build.

candidates.title: Desktop Screen Corner Preference Screen
candidates.change: Introduces a new dedicated screen allowing users to pick which corner of their desktop screen the pet will reside in.
candidates.why: Support emails report post-onboarding confusion around desktop pet placement and behavior (3 complaints). Setting position early sets expectations.

new_screen_corner.headline: Choose Where Your Pet Lives
new_screen_corner.body: Select your preferred desktop corner so your pet stays out of your workspace way.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a desktop screen position preference screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Target step choose_path loses 23.8% of users. Solves reported post-onboarding positioning confusion, but requires a new screen.

candidates.title: Companion Greeting Style Selector Flow
candidates.change: Adds a flow screen to let users customize how the pet greets them when launched (energetic wave, subtle purr, or quiet icon).
candidates.why: Support mail shows confusion after onboarding regarding pet controls and interactions (3 emails). Introducing greeting styles builds familiarity with controls.

new_greeting_flow.headline: Select Companion Greeting Style
new_greeting_flow.body: Pick how your desktop pet should get your attention when active.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a companion greeting style selection flow within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Target step adoption has high drop-off (36.7%). Flow customization addresses support feedback and leverages winning adoption new_flow pattern.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Activity Schedule Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a screen during adoption for setting sleep hours and active desk times for the desktop companion.
candidates.why: Support feedback notes users are unsure how to hide or manage desktop pet presence (3 emails). Pre-setting quiet hours reduces confusion.

new_schedule_screen.headline: Pet Rest & Active Hours
new_schedule_screen.body: Set quiet hours so your pet slumbers while you attend meetings or deep focus work.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a pet activity schedule screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High impact target step (adoption). Solves pet management confusion via new screen, though new_screen evidence remains thin.

home_intro.body: Press Alt + Pet (or Option + Pet) on your keyboard anytime to show, hide, or talk to your companion.
home_intro.hint: Pro tip: Double-click your pet to open its quick action menu on desktop.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Companion
waiting.body: We are assembling your pet's animations and sound effects.

decisions.title: Background Loading Desktop Ready Sound Notification

lessons_next: Predictions were consistently too high across tests compared to noise-corrected measurements.
adoption, new_flow changes were helpful, producing a confirmed winning test (though later tests showed no clear effect).
finish, redesign and sign_in, reorder changes were tested twice each and showed no positive effect, with some tests worsening performance.
home, wait_info changes were tested twice and showed no clear effect.
